definitions.explanation: The hollow area under the arm where it joins the body. Used in everyday, medical, and hygiene contexts.

examples.japanese: {脇|わき}の{下|した}で{体温|たいおん}を{測|はか}る。
examples.english: To take one's temperature under the armpit.

examples.japanese: {脇|わき}の{下|した}に{汗|あせ}をかいた。
{脇|わき}の{下|した}に{体温計|たいおんけい}を{挟|はさ}んで{五分|ごふん}{待|ま}ってください。
examples.english: Please place the thermometer under your arm and wait five minutes.

notes: In Japan, the standard way to measure body temperature is under the armpit ({脇|わき}の{下|した}で{測|はか}る), unlike in some Western countries where oral thermometers are common. Common collocations: {脇|わき}の{下|した}に{汗|あせ}をかく (to sweat under the arms), {脇|わき}の{下|した}に{挟|はさ}む (to hold under the arm). Also written as {腋|わき}の{下|した} with a different kanji. Sometimes shortened to simply {脇|わき} in casual speech.
